Liberation War Factsheet
2015-01-01T17:27:36+06:00 | The Daily Star
https://www.thedailystar.net/liberation-war-factsheet-52898

Bangladeshi Death toll: 3,000,000

Women raped: 200,000 to 400,000 (young as 8 , old as 75 )

23,000 abortions were performed in Dhaka

300-400 children were born at 22 abortion/delivery clinics in Dhaka

8,000 Pakistani soldiers died in combat

West Pakistani deployment in East Pakistan during 1971

Regular Army: 80,000

Rangers and militia: 24,000

Civilian forces: 24,000

Razakar, al-Badr and al-Shams: 50,000

Sources:

US State Department

Statistics of Genocide: Genocide and Mass Murder Since 1900, Chapter 8

Ekattorer Ghatok O Dalalera Ke Kothai

Mukti Juddho Kosh, Muntasir Mamun

Fortnightly secret report on the situation in East Pakistan, Ministry of Defence and Ministry of Internal Affairs, Government of Pakistan
